name: Devin Gallemore

experience.title: Sr AVP — Quantitative Model Solutions Specialist
experience.summary: Own Python orchestration for agentic investigation workflows and build evaluation and reporting capabilities for baseline comparisons, evidence inspection, and defect diagnosis. Work with investigators and product and technology leaders to translate requirements into prototypes and validate workflow behavior during platform migration. Earlier work includes anomaly detection and production liquidity-forecast monitoring.

bulletGroups.title: Agentic AI engineering, evaluation, and integration
bullets: Own Python orchestration for investigation workflows, implementing persistent state, conditional routing, specialized agents, and schema-validated outputs that support human review.

Built batch regression and reporting capabilities to compare baseline and candidate agent workflows, exposing differences alongside case evidence, generated explanations, execution logs, and output artifacts for defect investigation.
Added LLM-assisted summaries at run and case levels to highlight divergent outputs and suggest workflow refinements for human assessment.
Partner with investigators and product and technology leaders to translate changing requirements into working prototypes and testable workflow changes.
Validate workflow-state and output-artifact parity during migration to a web-based platform, supporting integration testing ahead of production rollout.
Refactored orchestration into reusable Python modules and helped establish shared GitHub branching, pull-request, and code-review practices; resolved unit-test and static-analysis findings.

bulletGroups.title: Quantitative systems experience
bullets: Built anomaly-detection tooling for commercial lending data, evaluating HBOS and Isolation Forest on high-dimensional, sparse features.
Owned SQL/Dremio monitoring and regression testing for production liquidity forecasts, investigating cash-flow discrepancies and upstream data defects.

experience.title: AVP — Quantitative Finance Analyst
experience.summary: Supported production forecasting for liquidity, capital, and stress testing, with a focus on root-cause analysis and automated validation.
bullets: Supported production balance-sheet forecasting for liquidity, capital, and stress testing in Unix/Linux environments.
Investigated data inputs, configuration logic, and system dependencies; automated validation steps.

experience.title: AVP — Senior Asset Liability Analyst
experience.summary: Owned stress testing and balance-sheet forecasting for HTM and BOLI portfolios, turning scenario analysis into decision support.
bullets: Owned enterprise stress testing and balance-sheet forecasting for held-to-maturity and bank-owned life insurance portfolios.
Delivered scenario analysis to senior stakeholders and built Python/Unix automation for production forecasting workflows.
